summary: Tested new admin-only Azure app credentials feature (/api/admin/ms-config + /integrations UI). 12/12 pytest backend tests pass (auth 403 for non-admin, GET/PUT/DELETE, validation, secret encryption-at-rest via Mongo inspection, secret preservation on partial update, SMTP forgot-password regression). Frontend: admin sees ms-config-card, filling client_id/tenant/secret and clicking save-ms-config flips badge from 'Not configured' to 'Configured'. Non-admin does not see the card. Cleanup completed - db.app_settings ms_graph doc deleted.

issues: Save success toast was not detected via [role=status]/toast selectors after save; badge does flip to 'Configured' so the state update works. Consider verifying that a success toast actually renders (may be too quickly dismissed or missing test-id).

action_items: Optional: add a data-testid on the save success toast in Integrations.js (e.g. data-testid=ms-config-toast) for reliable test detection.

GET returns tenant/client_id from env if DB unset - correct DB-first with env fallback per spec.
server.py is >1400 lines; consider splitting admin routes into a router module.
